L107: Show! Music Core Chart winners (2024)
L108: ---
L109: The Show! Music Core Chart is a 【38†record chart】 on the South Korean 【39†MBC】 television music program 【40†Show! Music Core】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【41†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.
L110: 
L111: In 2024, 27 singles reached number one on the chart, and 23 acts have been awarded a first-place trophy. Starting from the April 13 show, a song can win a maximum of three times.^{【42†[1]】}
